document.title: Usama Bin Ladin: Bin Ladin Uses Recent Interviews to Assert Right to WMD, and to Threaten U.S. and U.K Over Iraq (Islama 09420)
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), Mullah Omar Called Washington in 1998, New Documents Show
document.note: [Secret (NODIS)] Reports two bin Laden interviews since the August strikes. He asserts a right to use WMD and urges Muslims to kill U.S., British and Israeli civilians, citing Iraq strikes. He denies involvement in the Africa bombings, alleges a Saudi hit squad, and describes mutual respect with the Taliban.

persons.name: Usama Bin Ladin
persons.role: Leader of terrorist network sheltered in Afghanistan; gave press interviews Dec 1998

mentions.quote: USAMA BIN LADIN HAS GIVEN HIS FIRST PRESS INTERVIEWS SINCE THE AUGUST 20 U.S. AIR STRIKES ON HIS TERRORIST NETWORK
THE TALIBAN WILL BE HELD STRICTLY ACCOUNTABLE FOR ANY FUTURE TERRORIST INCIDENTS TIED TO BIN LADIN

East Africa bombings; Bin Ladin denied involvement but supported such attacks

relationships.detail: Bin Ladin affirmed knowing Salim, praising him as one of the best men he met; Salim led prayers for the Arabs at a Peshawar mosque and worked with relief groups.
relationships.quote: (SALIM) IS ONE OF THE BEST MEN I EVER MET -- HE LED PRAYERS AT PESHAWAR MOSQUE FOR THE ARABS

relationships.quote: HE LED PRAYERS AT PESHAWAR MOSQUE FOR THE ARABS AND ALSO WORKED WITH THE RELIEF GROUPS

relationships.quote: BUT HE LEFT SUDAN FOR GERMANY FOUR YEARS AGO.

relationships.quote: THE SAUDI GOVERNMENT HAD SENT A HIT SQUAD TO MURDER HIM IN KANDAHAR

relationships.quote: YUSUFZAI ALSO ASSERTED THAT HE HAD SPOKEN TO DR. AYMAN ZAWAHIRI

relationships.quote: THE TALIBAN, BIN LADIN RELATED, HAVE BUCKED MASSIVE PRESSURE ON THEM TO EXPEL HIM

relationships.detail: Bin Ladin and the Taliban respect each other as good Muslims.
relationships.quote: BIN LADIN AND THE TALIBAN RESPECTED EACH OTHER BECAUSE THEY BOTH CONSIDER EACH OTHER GOOD MUSLIMS

relationships.detail: Bin Ladin said he wants to stay in Afghanistan for the time being.
relationships.quote: FOR THE TIME BEING, I WANT TO STAY IN AFGHANISTAN

relationships.quote: UNDER PRESSURE FROM THE CHRISTIAN-JEWISH COALITION TO EXPEL ME

relationships.quote: WE COULD APPROACH THE TALIBAN TO HIGHLIGHT BIN LADIN'S LATEST THREATS

relationships.detail: Eastham is Chargé d'affaires who classified and signed the cable.
relationships.quote: CLASSIFIED BY CDA ALAN EASTHAM

relationships.detail: The cable refers to air strikes on his terrorist network, which Bin Ladin heads.
relationships.quote: AUGUST 20 U.S. AIR STRIKES ON HIS TERRORIST NETWORK

key_claims: Bin Ladin gave his first press interviews since the 20 Aug 1998 US strikes, contradicting Taliban assurances that he was barred from speaking to press.
Bin Ladin asserted his nation's right to possess weapons of mass destruction while denying seeking them.
Bin Ladin called on Muslims to kill US, UK and Israeli civilians citing the Iraq attack.
Bin Ladin denied involvement in the 7 Aug East Africa bombings but supported anyone attacking the US.
Bin Ladin claimed Saudi government sent a hit squad to kill him in Kandahar, now jailed there.
The Embassy recommends warning the Taliban they will be held accountable for future terrorism tied to Bin Ladin.
